40668344.model_description: Review summarizing MRI radiologic-molecular correlations (e.g., T2-FLAIR mismatch sign, transmantle-like sign) in pediatric-type low-grade gliomas, including machine learning approaches that predict molecular subtypes (e.g., BRAF fusion vs. BRAF V600E) from imaging features; no single model detailed.
40668344.study_design: narrative review (Part II of a series)

40706293.clinical_problem: using an AI-driven pipeline on dynamic T2* fetal MRI to detect and quantify subclinical uterine contractions and their relationship to placental function
40706293.patient_population: 821 dynamic fetal MRI scans from pregnancies between 15 and 41 weeks gestation (uncomplicated and placental insufficiency)
40706293.model_description: Input: dynamic T2* relaxometry fetal MRI scans; output: automated placental and fetal brain segmentation feeding a dynamic signal analysis pipeline that detects and quantifies uterine contractile activity.
40706293.headline_result: contractile activity detected in 19% of cases; activity increased with advancing gestational age, peaking the week before delivery
40706293.study_design: retrospective database analysis using an automated deep-learning pipeline

40800006.exclusion_reason: dental imaging (panoramic radiographs) age estimation, excluded per dental exclusion criterion

40804817.clinical_problem: role of bowel ultrasound (including emerging AI-enhanced analysis) in early detection and diagnosis of necrotizing enterocolitis in preterm infants
40804817.patient_population: preterm infants with suspected or confirmed NEC (review of 101 studies)
40804817.model_description: Scoping review of bowel ultrasound for NEC diagnosis; notes emerging AI-enhanced ultrasound analysis and ultra-high-frequency ultrasound as tools with potential to improve diagnostic precision, without describing a specific AI model in detail.

40866284.model_family: computer-aided detection (CAD), transfer learning with deep learning models
40866284.clinical_problem: developing computer-aided detection systems for reading chest radiographs to screen, diagnose, and grade severity of tuberculosis in children
40866284.patient_population: children with tuberculosis evaluated by chest radiograph in primary care settings
40866284.model_description: Review of computer-aided detection (CAD) approaches, largely using transfer learning from existing deep learning CXR models, for pediatric tuberculosis screening, diagnosis and severity stratification; discusses the current lack of approved pediatric CAD systems and the need for large pediatric CXR datasets.
40866284.release_evidence: CAD systems ... have been developed and approved for tuberculosis triage in adults but not in children

41045051.exclusion_reason: non-imaging viscoelastic coagulation testing (TEG/ROTEM) review; AI mentioned only briefly as a future direction

38184938.clinical_problem: rapid, non-invasive pre-surgical classification of medulloblastoma molecular subgroup using metabolite profiles measurable by in vivo MR spectroscopy
38184938.patient_population: 86 medulloblastomas from 59 male and 27 female pediatric patients
38184938.model_description: Input: tumor metabolite concentrations (10 metabolites quantifiable by in vivo MR spectroscopy); output: predicted medulloblastoma molecular subgroup (WNT, SHH, Group3, Group4), via a support vector machine classifier.
38184938.dataset_size: 86 medulloblastoma tumor samples (59 male, 27 female patients)
38184938.headline_result: tissue-based SVM classifier cross-validated accuracy 89% (100% for WNT); in vivo MRS-adapted classifier accuracy 90% for SHH/Group3/Group4
38184938.study_design: retrospective diagnostic model development with cross-validation

38189177.clinical_problem: estimating gestational age from brief ultrasound videos as a quality-control tool to flag substandard fetal biometry measurements
38189177.patient_population: pregnant patients, second and third trimester
38189177.model_description: Input: brief 'fly-to' cineloop ultrasound videos acquired during routine biometry; output: estimated gestational age, used to flag grossly inaccurate (e.g. novice-level) biometry measurements.
38189177.headline_result: MAE 3.87±0.07 days (vs 4.80±0.10 days expert biometry); AUC 0.93 for flagging gross errors, sensitivity 81.0%, specificity 89.9%
38189177.study_design: retrospective model development and validation against expert measurement

38261172.clinical_problem: predicting risk of early-life respiratory infections and childhood asthma from ultrasound-monitored fetal lung growth
38261172.patient_population: pregnant women in a pregnancy cohort with serial fetal lung ultrasound; offspring followed through infancy and to age 5
38261172.model_description: Input: serially measured fetal lung size on transabdominal ultrasound plus clinical variables; output: predicted risk/number of early-life respiratory infections and risk of early-onset asthma at age 5, using XGBoost regression/classification models.
38261172.headline_result: model R2 values 0.92, 0.90 and 0.93 for the three prediction tasks
38261172.study_design: prospective birth cohort study with machine learning model development and internal train/test validation

38315343.model_family: YOLOv5 (deep learning object detector) with multimodal (age/gender) channel integration
38315343.clinical_problem: automated detection and localization of hip joint anatomical landmarks on pelvic radiographs to diagnose developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) in infants and children
38315343.patient_population: 7,750 pelvic X-ray images, ages 4 months to 16 years, various DDH severities
38315343.model_description: Input: pelvic radiographs plus patient age and gender as additional channels; output: detected hip joint landmarks and DDH severity classification (normal, suspected/mild/heavy dislocation) via an enhanced YOLOv5 deep learning network.
38315343.headline_result: mAP0.5-0.95 83.1%, diagnostic accuracy 86.7%; F1 scores 90.9% (normal), 79.8% (suspected dislocation), 63.5% (mild dislocation), 97.4% (heavy dislocation)
38315343.study_design: retrospective model development and internal evaluation

38336167.exclusion_reason: animal study (juvenile tree shrews) using ocular OCT; non-radiologic imaging and non-human

38339907.model_family: atlas-based direct tract mapping (compared with deep-learning method TractSeg)
38339907.clinical_problem: rapid, robust segmentation of white matter fiber tracts on diffusion MRI for neurosurgical planning, including in pediatric and adult brain tumor patients
38339907.patient_population: two public healthy diffusion MRI datasets (TractoInferno, Human Connectome Project) plus a clinical dataset comprising pediatric and adult brain tumor scans
38339907.model_description: Input: diffusion MRI fiber orientation distribution data; output: tract-specific probability maps of white matter tract location, generated by registering atlas-derived orientation/spatial priors (built from 10-20 training samples) to the subject, avoiding streamline tractography at application time.
38339907.dataset_size: 10-20 training samples for atlas construction; evaluated on public datasets (TractoInferno, HCP) plus a pediatric and adult brain tumor clinical dataset
38339907.headline_result: high agreement with established techniques (streamline tractography, TractSeg); processing time <3 min per subject; higher robustness on tumor/resection scans
38339907.study_design: retrospective method development and comparative evaluation

38370435.clinical_problem: characterizing and detecting multiple sclerosis lesions on brain MRI in pediatric patients using radiomic features
38370435.patient_population: eleven scans from pediatric multiple sclerosis patients
38370435.model_description: Input: 60 radiomic (texture) features extracted from T2-FLAIR brain MRI; output: logistic regression classification distinguishing MS lesions from normal tissue.

38398675.clinical_problem: reviewing deep learning applications in fetal ultrasound anomaly screening of the heart and brain, including biometric measurement, standard plane recognition, and disease diagnosis
38398675.patient_population: fetuses undergoing obstetric anomaly ultrasound scans (review of published literature)
38398675.model_description: Review of deep-learning-based AI applications in fetal ultrasound anomaly scanning of the heart and brain: automatic biometric measurement, standard-plane recognition, and anomaly diagnosis; no single model described.

38413564.exclusion_reason: adult schizophrenia study, no pediatric population

38415119.exclusion_reason: bibliometric analysis of the neonatal MRI research literature, not itself an AI/ML radiology study

38480869.clinical_problem: improving diagnosis of pediatric pneumonia (and distinguishing bacterial vs viral) from chest X-rays despite scarce labeled pediatric data
38480869.patient_population: pediatric chest X-ray dataset (children, particularly under 5), pretraining on adult chest X-rays then fine-tuning on pediatric pneumonia dataset
38480869.model_description: Input: pediatric chest X-ray images; output: classification of normal vs. pneumonia, and further into bacterial vs. viral pneumonia, using a Masked Autoencoder pretrained (self-supervised) on adult chest X-rays and fine-tuned on a pediatric pneumonia dataset.
38480869.headline_result: AUC 0.996, accuracy 95.89% (normal vs pneumonia); accuracy 93.86% for 3-class (normal/bacterial/viral)
38480869.study_design: retrospective model development with self-supervised pretraining and internal evaluation

38486373.model_family: radiomics (various ML classifiers, pooled across studies)
38486373.clinical_problem: diagnostic accuracy of MRI-based radiomics for prenatal diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum
38486373.model_description: Systematic review and meta-analysis of MRI-based radiomic models for diagnosing placenta accreta spectrum, using histopathology as reference standard; pooled diagnostic performance is reported, not a single model.

38499706.model_family: transfer learning deep learning model (segmentation + image fusion)
38499706.clinical_problem: early prediction of bronchopulmonary dysplasia in preterm infants from chest radiographs
38499706.patient_population: 1,491 chest radiographs for lung segmentation dataset; 1,021 chest radiographs of preterm infants for BPD prediction dataset
38499706.model_description: Input: chest radiographs of preterm infants (as early as ≤24 hours postnatal age); output: automated lung region segmentation (transfer learning) followed by image-fusion-based prediction of bronchopulmonary dysplasia risk, compared against expert diagnostic accuracy.
38499706.dataset_size: 1,491 CXRs (segmentation) + 1,021 CXRs (BPD prediction) of preterm infants
38499706.headline_result: lung segmentation Dice 0.960; BPD prediction model exceeded diagnostic accuracy of experts
38499706.study_design: retrospective model development and internal evaluation

38583576.clinical_problem: comparing traditional 2D Cobb angle measurement to automated 3D Cobb angle measurement methods using weight-bearing 3D imaging in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
38583576.model_description: Input: weight-bearing 3D spine imaging; output: automated 3D segmentation of the spine and femoral heads using a 3D-UNet deep learning model, from which Cobb angles are automatically calculated by three different 3D geometric methods and compared to manual 2D measurement.
38583576.headline_result: Plane Projection Method values not significantly different from 2D method; Analytical and Plane Intersecting Methods gave significantly larger estimates

38604525.exclusion_reason: multivariable/bivariate regression analysis of neuroimaging microstructure metrics; no machine learning model applied

38655903.model_family: deep learning segmentation + radiomics + random forest hybrid model
38655903.clinical_problem: assessing fetal growth restriction using automatic placental radiomic analysis on T2-weighted MRI combined with ultrasound-based fetal measurements and maternal clinical features
38655903.patient_population: 274 pregnant women (mean age 29.5±4.0) from two centers
38655903.model_description: Input: T2-weighted placental MRI (automatically segmented by a deep learning model), fused with fetal ultrasound measurements and maternal clinical features; output: a random-forest-based prediction of fetal growth restriction.
38655903.dataset_size: 274 pregnant women from two centers (training N=119, internal test N=40, time-independent validation N=43, external validation N=72)
38655903.headline_result: placenta segmentation Dice 90.0%; hybrid model AUROC 0.923 (internal test), 0.931 (time-independent), 0.880 (external validation)
38655903.study_design: retrospective multi-center model development with internal and external validation

38663350.model_family: AI-based automatic segmentation + statistical shape model (PCA)
38663350.clinical_problem: creating a three-dimensional statistical growth reference model of the mandible spanning birth to young adulthood to aid diagnosis, treatment planning and evaluation of mandibular growth abnormalities
38663350.patient_population: 678 mandibles from CT scans of children and young adults aged 0-22 years
38663350.model_description: Input: CT scans of the mandible; output: an automatically (AI-based) segmented 3D mandible shape, registered across subjects to build an open-source statistical shape growth model capturing age-related and sex-related variation.
38663350.release_evidence: the first open-source, three-dimensional statistical shape model of the mandible... presented growth model is accessible globally and free-of-charge

38667477.clinical_problem: reviewing the role of radiomics for diagnosis and predictive modeling in pediatric sarcomas (Ewing sarcoma, osteosarcoma)
38667477.patient_population: pediatric sarcoma patients (review of 10 studies from a search of 72 papers)
38667477.model_description: Systematic review of 10 radiomics studies in pediatric sarcoma using CT, MRI, PET/CT and PET/MRI, assessed for methodological quality (RQS, METRICS); covers diagnostic and prognostic/treatment-response radiomics applications, no single model detailed.
38667477.study_design: systematic review with methodological quality assessment (RQS/METRICS)

38720920.clinical_problem: reviewing AI applications (imaging, genetic diagnosis, risk prediction) for prenatal diagnosis of congenital heart disease
38720920.patient_population: fetuses undergoing prenatal CHD screening (review of published literature)
38720920.model_description: Review of AI methods for prenatal CHD diagnosis, covering imaging-based detection, genetic diagnosis, and risk prediction, with representative examples for each; discusses current limitations (variability, insufficiency, and independence of data).

38729337.exclusion_reason: general review of uterine fibroid diagnosis from adolescence to menopause; not pediatric-specific, AI mentioned only briefly as one complementary tool

38755985.exclusion_reason: dental panoramic radiograph classification, excluded per dental exclusion criterion

38864742.clinical_problem: assessing the reproducibility of radiomic features extracted from T2-weighted MRI in children with neuroblastoma, to support their use as imaging biomarkers for personalized diagnosis and prognosis
38864742.patient_population: 419 patients (mean age 29 months) with neuroblastic tumors diagnosed 2002-2023 (PRIMAGE project)
38864742.model_description: Input: T2/T2*-weighted MRI of neuroblastoma tumors, automatically segmented; output: 107 shape, first-order and second-order radiomics features, whose reproducibility under different image-processing and segmentation-mask settings is quantified.
38864742.headline_result: without normalization, only 5% of features remained highly reproducible; mask modifications yielded 70% feature stability; shape features CCC>0.90

38875769.model_family: hierarchical clustering analysis (unsupervised machine learning) on resting-state functional connectivity
38875769.clinical_problem: characterizing how infant brain language network connectivity relates to and predicts later phonological skills and school-age reading ability
38875769.patient_population: 76 infants (resting-state fMRI), 41 further assessed for word reading at school age; 7-year longitudinal cohort
38875769.model_description: Input: resting-state fMRI functional connectivity in infants; output: a modular infant language network identified via hierarchical clustering, whose inferior frontal module connectivity is used to predict kindergarten phonological skills and later word reading ability.
38875769.dataset_size: 76 infants (41 assessed on reading at school age)

38922031.model_family: transformer-based (Swin-UNETR) and UNETR neural network models
38922031.clinical_problem: optimizing automated fetal brain extraction/segmentation from resting-state functional MRI for prenatal neuroimaging research
38922031.patient_population: internal dataset 172 fetuses (519 images, 2018-2022); external dataset 131 fetuses (561 images)
38922031.model_description: Input: fetal resting-state fMRI images; output: automated fetal brain extraction/segmentation mask, produced by transformer-based models (Swin-UNETR, UNETR) compared against convolutional-network reference-standard models across gestational ages and scanner types.
38922031.dataset_size: internal: 172 fetuses/519 images; external: 131 fetuses/561 images
38922031.headline_result: Swin-UNETR mean Dice 0.92, BAHD 0.097; comparable performance to reference models in late-fetal period (>25 weeks), lower in midfetal period (≤25 weeks)
38922031.study_design: retrospective model development and internal/external cross-validation

38944698.clinical_problem: establishing reference ranges and automating measurement of fetal intracranial markers during the first trimester on ultrasound
38944698.patient_population: 4,233 singleton normal fetuses scanned at 11-13+6 weeks gestation
38944698.model_description: Input: 2D first-trimester ultrasound images of the fetal head; output: automated measurement of 10 key fetal intracranial markers across three standard head planes, compared to manual measurement for accuracy, consistency and speed.
38944698.headline_result: ICC>0.75, r>0.75 (AI vs manual); average absolute error 0.124-0.178 mm; AI 100% detection rate for abnormal cases; measurement time 0.49s (65x faster than manual)
38944698.study_design: retrospective model development and validation against manual measurement

38987512.clinical_problem: validating a radiation-free machine learning method to automatically measure the coronal Cobb angle on 3D spinal ultrasonographs in children with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
38987512.patient_population: 144 3D spinal ultrasonographs from children with AIS (70 training, 74 testing/144 curves)
38987512.model_description: Input: 3D spinal ultrasonograph images; output: automatically measured coronal curve (Cobb) angle with displayed predicted laminae centers, compared to manual measurement by an experienced rater.
38987512.headline_result: ICC2,1=0.81, SEM=1.4°; 75% of measurements within 5° clinical acceptance; measurement time 36±7s
38987512.study_design: prospective method validation study (SOSORT 2024 award winner)
